summary: Round 9 ERP Phase A tested end to end. Backend: new pytest suite test_round9_erp_phase_a.py has 10 tests: 8 pass and 2 fail because of real bugs. It covers ERP gating (402 / superadmin grant), parties, projects, quotations, invoices (finalize -> SAL voucher, billing math, IGST vs CGST/SGST, edit-finalized versions updating the voucher, cancel, numbers never reused, payments, CN, overdue, email), the permission matrix for all 5 roles, and a trial balance / backup regression check. Frontend: tested the locked screen, dashboard stats and tabs, Clients & Vendors create/history/GSTIN error, project create/edit/KPIs, document upload/download/delete, the quotation editor (live preview, 3 templates keep data, save, sent, accept, convert to invoice navigates), the invoice editor (retention/advance update net and words, finalize confirm, payment, credit note, edit finalized -> invoice-versions, print window, WhatsApp, duplicate, cancel dialog needs a reason), ERP Settings permission save/revert, Platform erp-grant-button, and the new Users roles. All of these work except the debit note flow (backend bug).

critical.issue: Always returns 400 'Account ledger must belong to Purchase Accounts'. erp_sales.add_note builds a voucher of type debit_note with the SALES ledger as account_ledger_id, but accounting.build_item_entries requires a purchase-group ledger for debit_note (Tally-style purchase return). Customer debit notes on sales invoices are impossible, so the 'debit note increases balance' feature is broken in both API and UI (invoice-debit-note button).

The number is saved in erp_used_numbers BEFORE create_voucher. If posting fails (e.g. no financial year for the date, a missing GST ledger, a locked FY), the invoice stays draft but its number is burned. A draft with a manual number can then never be finalized ('Invoice number X is already used'), and auto numbers leave gaps in the GST invoice series. Reproduced: draft dated 2024-05-01 with manual number -> finalize 400 'No financial year' -> fix date -> finalize 400 'already used'.

minor.issue: The duplicate copies sales_order_no and sales_order_date from the source (excluded keys miss them). The new draft shows 'Sales order: SO/..' and once accepted, convert to sales_order returns 400 'Already converted to sales order'. Add sales_order_no and sales_order_date to the exclusion list (and consider project_id when the source was converted to a project).

create_voucher, update_voucher and cancel_voucher are called directly, which skips the WRITE dependency's expired-subscription check. A business with an active ERP plan but an expired Easy Books trial/subscription (read-only books) can still post SAL/RCT/CN vouchers through ERP. Code review finding, not run (it would mean changing expired@test.in data).

ERP note numbers (CN/2026-27/0004) use the same format as Easy Books voucher numbers (CN/2026-27/0010), so two different documents can share a number like CN/2026-27/0004. This confuses users and the GST register. Consider a distinct prefix (e.g. ECN/) or reuse the voucher number.
The audit entry uses entity_id=did, so document deletes do not appear in the project's Activity panel (uploads do).
Usage counts are not scoped by business_id. Harmless with UUIDs but inconsistent.

Flaky only under the default -n 2 run (KeyError voucher_no from next-number: 'No financial year found'). Passes with -n 0. Likely another class switching the working FY in parallel. This test file existed before this round.

ui_bugs.issue: Debit note save fails with the backend 400 error described above

issues: The 'CANCELLED' marker in the green header is red text on a dark green background and is almost invisible. Use white text on a red pill or a diagonal watermark.
Disc % and GST % inputs wrap onto a second row with no labels. Once filled, the placeholders disappear, so users can't tell which field is which. Add column headers or labels.
Date fields use the browser's native date input instead of the shadcn Calendar component.
With no manager or dates set it shows 'PM: - · - →' placeholder clutter. Hide empty parts.

action_items: Fix ERP debit note posting: allow a debit_note voucher against a sales ledger for ERP (or post a supplementary 'sales' voucher), so the party is Dr and sales/GST are Cr

Finalize invoice: create the voucher first (or wrap it in try and roll back), and only insert into erp_used_numbers after posting succeeds. Also release a burned manual number for still-draft invoices
Quotation duplicate: exclude sales_order_no and sales_order_date
Make ERP write actions respect the expired-subscription read-only check (call status_of / WRITE logic inside erp() for non-view actions)
Make the 'CANCELLED' marker in the invoice/quotation templates readable
Optional: distinct ERP CN/DN number prefix, labels for the line-item Disc/GST fields, shadcn date picker
critical_code_review_comments: erp_sales.add_note: debit_note -> purchase ledger rule in accounting.build_item_entries conflicts with ERP use (bug above)

erp_sales.finalize_invoice: non-atomic reservation of the number before voucher creation (bug above); a race between two finalizes of the same draft is also possible because there is no status check-and-set
erp_sales.duplicate_quote: blacklist-based copying leaks state fields (sales_order_no). Prefer whitelisting the fields to copy
erp_core.erp(): ERP permission matrix lets an admin uncheck their own non-settings rights (only 'settings' is forced for admin). Consider forcing admin to have all rights
Auth playbook: bcrypt $2b$ OK, 5-fail lockout -> 429 OK, Bearer token auth (no app httpOnly cookie), CORS allow-origin '*'. Both auth points existed before this round and are unchanged

success_rate.frontend: 95% (every requested flow works except debit note)

rca of the issue: Debit note: accounting.build_item_entries sets want='sales' only for sales and credit_note, and anything else (incl. debit_note) needs a purchase ledger. erp_sales.add_note passes _sales_ledger -> 400. Number burn: finalize_invoice inserts into erp_used_numbers, then awaits create_voucher, which raises HTTPException (e.g. _fy_for 'No financial year') with no rollback. On the next finalize, _number_used finds the reserved number. Duplicate quote: the exclusion set is ('id','number','status','created_at','cancel_reason','converted_to') and the *_at sweep removes sales_order_date? No: sales_order_date doesn't end with _at, so both sales_order_no and sales_order_date are copied.
